HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Meta.Meta__Description: Block coursing for elevations - stretcher bond at the co-ordinating size, 450 x 225 mm, each course half a block along from the one below.
HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Every length here is PAPER millimetres, like the dash patterns in Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json, so the hatch measures the same on the sheet at 1:20 and at 1:100. Pattern scale adjusts from there.
HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Meta.Meta__RealSize: Drawn at 1:50: a 450 x 225 mm block is 9 x 4.5 mm on paper. SET PATTERN SCALE TO 50 / THE DRAWING SCALE for true courses: 0.5 at 1:100, 1 at 1:50, 2.5 at 1:20.
HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Meta.Meta__WhySeams: Bed joints run edge to edge, 2.25 mm in from the top and bottom edges; the perpends of the course that wraps the seam are two halves meeting on it, square on. No line comes within 2.25 mm of a side edge.

HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the pattern lists.
HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Identity.Identity__Note: Fair-faced blockwork on an ELEVATION. For blockwork cut in section or on plan use Blockwork (Criss-Cross).

HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.
HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Tile.Tile__Note: Two blocks wide by two courses high.

HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the pattern draws with until a use sets its own. The stroke is 0.25 pt (0.0882 mm) at scale 1 and grows with the pattern scale; a line weight typed in the panel does not. 'inherit' takes the colour of whatever carries the hatch - a vector's edge colour - until a pattern colour is picked.

HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's own origin, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres. Strokes only: the PDF stamps a tile as lines and never fills one.

Courses.Glyph__Note: Two bed joints, then the perpends; the second course straddles the seam, so each of its perpends is two pieces.

HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Placements.Place__Note: The whole tile is one glyph at the origin

HatchPattern__BlockCoursing__Bounds.Bounds__Description: Scale 1 is real size at 1:50. 0.10 is 1:500 and 10 is 1:5.
